annotation_semantics.name: reference ink annotations
annotation_semantics.warning: The public ink labels are not absolute physical ground truth: the official description says they start from hand annotation and are refined through iterative pseudo-labelling.
annotation_semantics.use: Evaluate only inside the published supervision mask; report this limitation with every score.

split_policy.development: Only 0139/w035 may be used for parameter selection, thresholds or ablations.
split_policy.validation: 0139/w039 and Paris4/w02 remain unopened and immutable until code, metrics and DEV choices are frozen.
leakage_controls: No random pixel or overlapping-tile split.
No threshold, morphology or ranking-weight selection on VALIDATION.
Report 0139/w039 and the external Paris4 holdout separately; do not pool away a domain failure.

evaluation.primary_unit: non-overlapping 512x512 surface regions clipped by the supervision mask
evaluation.uncertainty: surface-block bootstrap confidence intervals; blocks are never split between resamples
evaluation.freeze_gate: Validation access is allowed only after implementation tests, DEV ablations, score direction, thresholds and report schema are frozen.
